c1.title: 内容源插拔架构状态迁移拓扑
c1.caption: 图 2.1：从外部讲义源到引擎渲染与发布的完整流转闭环
c1.code:
graph LR
    A[外部讲义源\nExternal Sources] -->|--mount| B(挂载开发态\nMounted Engine)
    B -->|npm run dev| C[实时渲染走查\nVitePress Dev]
    B -->|--verify| D{契约双向校验}
    D -->|PASS| E[生产构建打包\nProduction Build]
    D -->|FAIL| B
    B -->|--unmount / --clean| F[重置基准态\nReset Baseline]
    F -->|git push| G[开源公开发布\nPublic Release]
